cohort: The study participants were 182 preterm deliveries recorded in Ende Hospital, Indonesia, between September 2014 and August 2015, comparing those born to mothers with PIH versus normotensive mothers.
finding: Women with PIH had lower birth weight and a higher risk of birthing small for gestational age (SGA) babies compared to normotensive women in preterm deliveries (32-35 weeks gestation).
birth_weight: All birth weights of preterm babies were included; birth weight and SGA/LGA classification were primary outcomes.
gest_age: Preterm deliveries (specifically analyzed at 32-36 weeks gestation)
